altText: A male House Finch in a bare shrub: red on his forehead and throat, a plain brown back, and brown streaks running down his sides.
A male House Finch perched among bare branches, red on the head and breast.
A female House Finch, brown and streaky all over with a plain face and no stripe over the eye.
A female House Finch among red berries, showing the brown streaks down her front.
